scope: NEXUS scheduler implementation evidence; source snapshots; not adopted governance copies

workflows.content:
name: NEXUS Drive to GitHub
# Read-only change feed WORK/REPORTS -> GitHub artifact + job summary. No commits, no Drive writes.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "7,37 * * * *"   # iterative polling every 30 min (scheduled runs may be delayed)
  workflow_dispatch:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [drive_change]    # optional: Drive push-notification relay -> GitHub (see docs/NEXUS-DRIVE-GITHUB-MCP.md)
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: nexus-drive-poll
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  poll:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Restore Drive page token
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: .nexus-state
          key: nexus-drive-token-${{ github.run_id }}
          restore-keys: nexus-drive-token-
      - name: Poll Drive changes (read-only)
        env:
          NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID }}
          NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          NEXUS_GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NEXUS_GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN }}
        run: python tools/drive_changes_poll.py
      - name: Assert initialization or live poll evidence with checkpoint (fail closed)
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: python tools/assert_operational_evidence.py drive-poll reports/drive-changes/status.json --checkpoint .nexus-state/drive-changes-token.json
      - name: Save Drive page token
        if: ${{ hashFiles('.nexus-state/drive-changes-token.json') != '' }}
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: .nexus-state
          key: nexus-drive-token-${{ github.run_id }}
      - name: Job summary
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: |
          echo '### NEXUS Drive -> GitHub' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '```json' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          cat reports/drive-changes/status.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" || true
          echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q BLOCKED reports/drive-changes/status.json; then echo "::warning::Drive credentials missing - run tools/configure_drive_oauth.py --publish"; fi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        if: ${{ always() }}
        with:
          name: nexus-drive-changes-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: reports/drive-changes/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

name: NEXUS Monitor
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 * * * *"   # hourly stabilization at :17 UTC; scheduled runs may be delayed; Actions usage only
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
concurrency:
  group: nexus-monitor-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  monitor:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: python -m pip install jsonschema
      - name: Validate and report repository state
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python tools/monitor_repo.py
      - name: Assert operational monitor evidence (fail closed)
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: python tools/assert_operational_evidence.py monitor reports/monitor/report.json

      - name: Export commit-bound dashboard snapshot
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: python tools/export_dashboard.py --source-commit "$GITHUB_SHA"

      - name: Skill and agent inventory (read-only)
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: python tools/skill_inventory.py

      - name: Advisory LLM analysis of monitor findings
        if: ${{ always() }}
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          OPENAI_MODEL: ${{ vars.OPENAI_MODEL || 'gpt-4.1-mini' }}
          NEXUS_LLM_EXPORT_APPROVED: ${{ vars.NEXUS_LLM_EXPORT_APPROVED }}
        run: python tools/monitor_llm.py

      - name: Preserve monitoring evidence even on failure
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: nexus-monitor-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            reports/monitor/
            reports/skills/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

name: NEXUS GitHub to WORK
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [NEXUS Monitor]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source_run_id:
        description: Completed NEXUS Monitor run on main to deliver or retry
        required: true
        type: string
      resume_delivery_run_id:
        description: Optional earlier delivery workflow run whose journal must be restored
        required: false
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: nexus-work-delivery-single-writer
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  deliver:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      # Privileged workflow_run: execute trusted default-branch tooling only.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Validate source run id
        env:
          SOURCE_RUN: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id || inputs.source_run_id }}
        run: |
          [[ "$SOURCE_RUN" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 2
          echo "SOURCE_RUN=$SOURCE_RUN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Restore journal from previous attempt of this delivery run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RESUME_DELIVERY_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.resume_delivery_run_id }}
        run: python tools/restore_delivery_state.py
      - name: Check Drive credentials and exact WORK capability (read-only)
        env:
          NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID }}
          NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          NEXUS_GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NEXUS_GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN }}
        run: python tools/configure_drive_oauth.py --check --require-write --check-output reports/delivery/preflight.json
      - name: Deliver and verify raw bytes
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID }}
          NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.NEXUS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          NEXUS_GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NEXUS_GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN }}
        run: python tools/deliver_work.py --run-id "$SOURCE_RUN"
      - name: Preserve receipts, failures and preallocated IDs
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: nexus-delivery-state-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: reports/delivery/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          # Dashboard fixtures refer to historical revisions and verify ancestry.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: python -m pip install jsonschema pytest
      - run: python -m pytest -q tests
      - name: Artifact registry fail-closed tests
        run: python -m pytest -q tests/test_artifact_registry_gate.py
      - run: python tools/validate_registry.py
      # Inventory is not populated yet; report NO_DATA rather than claim PASS.
      - run: python tools/validate_knowledge.py --allow-empty
      - run: python tools/knowledge_health.py --allow-empty

      - name: CPLM local invariants
        run: |
          pip install -r cplm-implementation/requirements.txt
          PYTHONPATH=cplm-implementation python -m unittest discover -s cplm-implementation/tests -v

sourcepack_limitations: workflow snapshots precede diagnostic75 merge; deployed code and runs are recorded in github evidence
baseline SHA relates to text/plain export representation
